subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Kamisato Estate to see Kamisato Ayaka

20070101.text: Traveler, Paimon... It is a pleasure to finally meet you both face-to-face, hehe.

20070102.text: I have heard all about how you helped our three friends. My sincerest thanks to you.

20070105.text: *sigh* Yeah... short of getting them their Visions back, it seems like there's no way to really help them...

20070106.text: Um, Ayaka — how come this time you get to come out and meet us in person?

20070107.text: Hehe, because now that you have done the three things I asked of you, I consider you to be my friends. As you will observe, I dispense with the screen for Thoma, also.

20070109.text: Wait a second, but isn't Thoma your, um... servant? Paimon's happy to help and all, but Paimon sure as heck did not sign up to be a servant!

20070110.text: Oh...! Ahaha, Paimon you are most entertaining. Thoma is first and foremost my friend, and was so before he ever became my attendant.

20070111.text: Oh, okay then... Ayaka, you seem pretty different out in the open compared to how you are behind the screen. Mmm... Alright, we can be friends.

20070929.text: Ooh, ooh, Paimon has a question though!

20070930.text: Oh? What would you like to know, Paimon?

20070931.text: Have you got a plan yet? To fight the Vision Hunt Decree?

20070932.text: To be honest... we do not.

20070934.text: Please, do not forget that challenging the Vision Hunt Decree is tantamount to challenging a deity. Coming to terms with that is already a difficult step to take.

20070935.text: So... So, what're we gonna do?

20070936.text: Well, for the moment, all we can do is to try and reduce the harm that is being caused by this decree.

20070937.text: For example, by providing Vision bearers with safe refuge, or manufacturing counterfeit Visions for them as a contingency measure.

20070938.text: You're telling Paimon that there are people out there who can make fake Visions!?

20070939.text: Don't underestimate the talents of the craftspeople in Hanamizaka. To the naked eye, their counterfeits are indistinguishable from the genuine article.

20070942.text: The problem we are facing right now is that Master Masakatsu, who was providing us with counterfeit Visions, has recently been arrested by the Tenryou Commission.

20070943.text: Oh darn! So they found out about it? Ugh...

20070944.text: Yes... We knew it was not a long-term solution and that it was only a matter of time before it would be exposed... But we cannot simply abandon Master Masakatsu.

20070201.text: Just hand it over, you don't want any trouble with me.

20070202.text: If you think your elemental powers are enough to resist the Vision Hunt Decree, then you'd better think again.

20070203.text: Believe me, you're not the first of your kind we've encountered... And we've seen the same unpleasant outcome time after time. You'd best save yourself the trouble.

20070204.text: Can't you make an exception? I just got this Vision — I won't even use it, I promise.

20070205.text: So this is the Vision Hunt Decree in action, huh? We can't just sit around and watch things unfold, can we?

20070208.text: Huh? There's someone trying to get our attention.

20070210.text: Huh, what's going on!? Can't you see we need to go help...

20070211.text: Shh! Quiet! Just sit tight and watch for a moment...

20070212.text: Hey! This isn't right, y'know! Just because you don't have a Vision doesn't mean you can sit back and watch others in trouble...

20070213.text: Huh? Hey wait... you do have a Vision!

20070214.text: Shh! If you don't keep your voice down, I won't have one much longer!

20070216.text: Hm, wise choice. Alright, let's go!

20070217.text: What should we do now? He's already given up his Vision... Doesn't he know what could happen to him after losing it?

20070218.text: Ugh, this is your fault. You're the one who stopped us from interfering!

20070219.text: Phew! Many thanks, Miss Yoimiya. If you hadn't swapped me a fake just now, I'm sure I would have lost it.

20070220.text: No worries! You put on quite the convincing performance!

20070223.text: Ohh, so that's what's going on here! And to think Paimon was about to unleash Paimonial wrath on Miss Yoimiya... hehehe... sorry about that.

20070224.text: Haha, ahh think nothing of it! I could tell from your reaction we were on the same side — you just didn't know it, y'know?

20070225.text: Alright — allow me to introduce myself. I'm Yoimiya, the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks. It ain't much, but it's honest work, hehe. Great to meet ya!

20070226.text: Practically everyone in Hanamizaka knows Yoimiya. She's the "Queen of the Summer Festival"! Without her and her fireworks, summer on Narukami Island just wouldn't be the same.

20070227.text: Whoa, that's quite the introduction! Paimon loves fireworks! It's nice to meet you.

20070228.text: Hee-hee, stop it Hanshirou, you'll embarrass me!

20070229.text: As for thanking me, you'd be better off thanking Master Masakatsu. He's the one that gave me the fake Visions in the first place.

20070230.text: His handiwork allowed me to keep my own Vision. Whew, I can't even imagine trying to run the business without it...

20070231.text: Yes, Master Masakatsu is a good man. It's too bad good people seldom get the recognition they deserve.

20070233.text: Huh? Do you guys know him too?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Police Station to help Master Masakatsu

20070301.text: Uh... Now that we're inside, this place is a whole lot creepier than Paimon imagined... Eh-he...

20070302.text: C'mon, this way! As long as we stay quiet, we've got a good chance!

20070303.text: I certainly wouldn't want to end up locked away in here... Let's find Master Masakatsu and get out of here.

20070304.text: We should split up. I've got a "little present" to prepare for Master Masakatsu, hehe... I'll be right back.

20070305.text: You sure? Alright then... Just be careful not to get caught!

20070401.text: Shh... quick, hide! Look over there...

20070403.text: ...Did you really think that little trick of yours could fool us?

20070404.text: Hehe... locking you up was just the beginning.

20070406.text: Oh no... Those Tenryou Commission brutes are torturing him.

20070407.text: If we don't come up with a way to break him out fast, then... Eh!? Yoimiya, when did you get back here...

20070410.text: Ugh... I can't bear to watch. If anything happens to Master Masakatsu, our whole plan will have been for nothing...

20070411.text: Hey, you there! What are you doing!?

20070413.text: W—We were just teaching him a little lesson... That's all.

20070415.text: That's Kujou Sara, adopted daughter of the Kujou Clan of the Tenryou Commission. She's also a general in the Shogun's Army. What's she doing here...?

20070702.text: Master Masakatsu! Sorry we took so long... Ugh... those awful guards!

20070703.text: C'mon, we've got no time to lose! They could be back any minute...

20070705.text: You were over there watching us this whole time, weren't you?

20070706.text: Yes. Leave, before I let my judgment get the better of me.

20070707.text: He's in serious condition, be sure he gets immediate medical attention.

20070709.text: Once he's recovered, it won't be long until I bring him right back.

20070710.text: Uh, well... Ahem, you can bet we'll do all we can to keep that from happening.

20070801.text: Phew! We're finally outta that creepy place.

20070802.text: Yes... Finally, I've made it out of there...

20070803.text: Master Masakatsu — how do you feel? Can you hold on?

20070804.text: Don't worry, I think I can make it to the infirmary without keeling over.

20070805.text: Thank you, all of you! I'll take him to get treated. I'll treat you to a round of drinks once this is all over!

20070806.text: Don't worry about us, just take care of Master Masakatsu!

20070807.text: Whew, good thing we were able to rescue him.

20070810.text: Right, Kujou Sara... Do you think she was making up for how the guards were treating him?

20070811.text: It seems as though there are some okay people among the ranks of the Tenryou Commission... Oh! Though Paimon would never agree with their actions in the Vision Hunt Decree, of course.

20070812.text: How about we go tell Ayaka and the others the good news?

20071002.text: Let's see what we've got here. Hmm, fresh fish fillets, shrimp, bamboo shoots...

20071003.text: Nice! You can't go wrong with these. Paimon can't wait!

20071004.text: Paimon never thought we'd be the only ones to actually put anything edible into the pot... Don't go wasting the rest now!

20071005.text: *sigh* This was possibly the scariest-looking hot pot Paimon's ever seen... Fortunately, Thoma ended up eating all the weird stuff.

20071006.text: You can say that again... But hey, at least I got the most points... Ugh, wait a moment... that doesn't feel good...

20071007.text: I'm afraid it's your own fault for adding all those strange ingredients Thoma. The soup flavor wasn't quite the same afterwards...

20071008.text: #Even with {NICKNAME}'s normal ingredients, I still couldn't guess any of them correctly.

20071009.text: #But weren't you the one who added those little cakes Ayaka? Hehe, I think {NICKNAME} ended up eating one.

20071010.text: Boiling cakes in hot pot... bleurgh... think of the texture...

20071011.text: I must apologize... To be perfectly honest, I thought the cakes would be a tasty addition.

20071012.text: Uh oh, I'm definitely not okay... Ugh, I need to lie down.

20071013.text: Whew... I feel like a new man.

20071014.text: Uh, you know, Thoma... all you had to do was guess wrong on purpose and it would've been someone else's turn. Talk about being competitive...

20071015.text: Haha, guess I've been feeling unlucky recently and wanted the God of Hot Pot's blessing.

20071016.text: Perhaps I did get a little carried away... Still, I couldn't be beaten at my own game first time around!

20071017.text: I think my luck has already taken a turn for the better — I can sense it!

20071018.text: So without further ado, I hereby declare that the winner of today's hot pot challenge is... me!

20071020.text: Ahh... good effort team, another important job taken care of. Next on the agenda: some well-earned rest and relaxation.

20071021.text: Yes, if the Tenryou Commission truly is as busy with preparations as Thoma claims, then some rest would be a welcome change of pace.

20071022.text: And with the extra time, there are some other matters I wish to attend to...

20071023.text: Let's all take some much-needed time off. After a few days' rest, we'll reconvene at the Komore Teahouse and discuss our next operation.

20071024.text: Downtime is hard to come by these days, so be sure to make the most of it!

20071025.text: I'll tidy things up here and start thinking about our ingredients for our next round, hehe.

20071027.text: Sure, why not! We should play again now that everyone knows the rules. I'll see you all later!

20071029.text: Hmm, seems we won't need to be visiting the Komore Teahouse for a while. Why don't we go explore some other places!

20070501.text: I see, so Kujou Sara stayed her hand. It would appear she still has some honor to her.

20070502.text: I wonder if we should try establishing contact with her... Perhaps we could coax out some information.

20070504.text: Don't forget, Kujou Sara is also carrying out the Vision Hunt Decree. She obeys the orders of the Raiden Shogun without question.

20070505.text: In her eyes, Master Masakatsu is of no threat to the decree. This is why she was so willing to allow his escape.

20070506.text: If our true motives were ever divulged, she would act against us without a second thought.

20070507.text: True... Though if you ask me, Master Masakatsu's release is an unexpected blessing.

20070508.text: #We are now one step closer to victory... and we couldn't have done it without Yoimiya and {NICKNAME}!

20070509.text: Hehe, you're turning out to be even more reliable than we expected.

20070512.text: #Indeed, things may have turned out very differently this time without the help of {NICKNAME}.

20070513.text: But if we wish to mount any sizable resistance against the Vision Hunt Decree... there is still much to be done.

20070514.text: It is time we make ready our next set of plans...

20070515.text: There's no need to rush, milady.

20070516.text: Things seem to have taken a turn for the better, at least. Not only have we rescued Master Masakatsu, but our list of allies appears to be growing.

20070517.text: Ah yes, which reminds me... The Tenryou Commission seems to be making preparations for a "celebration"... They call it a "ceremony" of sorts.

20070532.text: And the number of samurai out enforcing the Vision Hunt Decree seems to be waning. The days ahead may be more peaceful than usual.

20070518.text: A "ceremony," you say? Why would such a task be left to the Tenryou Commission?

20070519.text: I don't know, but I'm sure it has nothing to do with us. Anyway, with the Tenryou Commission busy with preparations, we should have a little more breathing room than usual.

20070520.text: Hmm, you do present a good point.

20070521.text: Being in a constant state of alert will only tire us further, perhaps a period of rest is in order.

20070523.text: I'd say a celebratory feast is in order. Might I suggest an evening of hot pot together!

20070524.text: Funny enough, I learned a new "hot pot game" recently. I'm sure you'll find it quite amusing!

20070525.text: A hot pot game? What's that? Well, as long as it has to do with eating...

20070526.text: Simply put, every person prepares an ingredient to add to the hot pot. Once the meal begins, we add all the ingredients together.

20070527.text: Then we take it in turns to close our eyes, pick an ingredient out of the pot, taste it, and guess whose ingredient it was.

20070528.text: Anyone who guesses correctly can go again, and whoever finishes the meal with the most points is declared the winner. Tradition even has it that the winner receives blessings from the God of Hot Pot.

20070529.text: Don't you think it sounds like fun? Hehe, I've been wanting to give it a try... In fact, I've already got my ingredients prepared!

20070530.text: You really do wanna play, huh!

20070531.text: Well, sounds like we've got our work cut out for us! Time to gather some ingredients. But... what should we choose?

20070902.text: Please, continue without me. I'll keep watch.

20070903.text: So, what's the deal with this place, anyway? What makes it your favorite meeting spot?

20070904.text: This is land that was gifted to the Yashiro Commission by the shogun. The Kamisato Clan has the exclusive right to plan, build, and repair any property on this land — and even to allow or deny access.

20070905.text: Such privileges exist due to the Yashiro Commission's role in managing ceremonial affairs. Oftentimes, it is not appropriate to discuss details in front of bystanders.

20070906.text: Ohh Paimon gets it — gotta keep a bit of mystery, right?

20070907.text: Once the number of ceremonial affairs conducted in the city began to decline, our forebears built a teahouse here. Only members of the Yashiro Commission are permitted to come and go as they please.

20070908.text: Makes sense. Perfect place for a secret base!

20070909.text: #In any case, we can talk freely here. I presume {NICKNAME}, you have a few questions that you wish to ask me?

20070910.text: What kind of god is the Raiden Shogun?

20070911.text: The Almighty Shogun... I have seen her on but only a few occasions, most of them formal ceremonies...

20070912.text: She inspires awe, commands respect, and exudes a sense of absolute authority. But as I recall, there was something else about her that struck me even more deeply...

20070913.text: It was her almost complete lack of any emotion. In that sense, she appeared to me to be less of a ruler and more of... well, an executive official, I suppose. Focused exclusively on her single goal of implementing Eternity, acting accordingly without feeling.

20070914.text: Is no one else fighting the Vision Hunt Decree?

20070915.text: The issue is this... For the vast majority of people, the Vision Hunt Decree is something that has no implications whatsoever.

20070916.text: After all, it is but a tiny minority of people who receive Visions. Moreover, it is not unknown for Visions to spark jealousy in others.

20070917.text: Because of this, the attitude of most people towards the Vision Hunt Decree is one of indifference.

20070918.text: How can they be like that...? Hmph, Paimon's getting mad...

20070919.text: Nevertheless, in addition to us, there is also the resistance on Watatsumi Island.

20070920.text: Resistance? You mean, like, an army fighting against the decree?

20070921.text: Yes, many who have lost or fear losing their Visions have rallied together under Sangonomiya on Watatsumi Island to form a resistance group.

20070922.text: To say a little more about Sangonomiya... Historically, there has always been some conflict between them and the Shogunate of Narukami Island due to their different belief systems.

20070923.text: But I do wonder whether there may be some other agenda behind their resistance movement, beyond merely fighting the Vision Hunt Decree...

20070924.text: Have you raised a formal objection to the Vision Hunt Decree?

20070925.text: Of course. We have tried on numerous occasions. Unfortunately, each time a proposal to repeal the decree arrives at Tenshukaku, it is promptly vetoed by both the Tenryou Commission and the Kanjou Commission, and subsequently scrapped...

20070926.text: They invariably adopt a stance of unconditional support for the shogun's decisions. They have no interest in discussing anything.

20070927.text: It almost makes one wonder whether they had a hand in the shogun's sudden decision to issue the Vision Hunt Decree...

20071102.text: Ooh, Paimon proposes we gather raging demon-level Jueyun Chilis, super salty Ham, Mist Flower Corollas...

20071103.text: This is already shaping up to be a hot pot to remember...

20071104.text: Ugh, my stomach! It feels like Yoimiya's fireworks are going off inside me...

20071105.text: Who would've guessed that Thoma would be the winner...? He ate practically all those weird ingredients without a second thought! Uh, Thoma? You okay buddy?

20071106.text: Salt-crusted herring, unripe Lavender Melon, flash-boiled dango... Oh, and whatever that thing was that nearly froze my tongue off...

20071107.text: Hold up, my life is starting to flash before my eyes... Time I call it a night, everyone...

20071108.text: Hehe, you've only got yourself to blame Thoma... All those strange things you ate were ingredients you added yourself.

20071109.text: #But weren't you the one who added those little cakes Ayaka? Hehe, I think {NICKNAME} ended up eating one.

20071110.text: Boiling cakes in hot pot... bleurgh... think of the texture...

20071111.text: I must apologize... To be perfectly honest, I thought the cakes would be a tasty addition.

20071112.text: Uh oh, I'm definitely not okay... Ugh, I need to lie down.

20071113.text: Whew... I feel like a new man.

20071114.text: Uh, you know, Thoma... all you had to do was guess wrong on purpose and it would've been someone else's turn. Talk about being competitive...

20071115.text: Haha, guess I've been feeling unlucky recently and wanted the God of Hot Pot's blessing.

20071116.text: Perhaps I did get a little carried away... Still, I couldn't be beaten at my own game first time around!

20071117.text: I think my luck has already taken a turn for the better — I can sense it!

20071118.text: So without further ado, I hereby declare that the winner of today's hot pot challenge is... me!

20071120.text: Ahh... good effort team, another important job taken care of. Next on the agenda: some well-earned rest and relaxation.

20071121.text: Yes, if the Tenryou Commission truly is as busy with preparations as Thoma claims, then some rest would be a welcome change of pace.

20071122.text: And with the extra time, there are some other matters I wish to attend to...

20071123.text: Let's all take some much-needed time off. After a few days' rest, we'll reconvene at the Komore Teahouse and discuss our next operation.

20071124.text: Downtime is hard to come by these days, so be sure to make the most of it!

20071125.text: I'll tidy things up here and start thinking about our ingredients for our next round, hehe.

20071127.text: Sure, why not! We should play again now that everyone knows the rules. I'll see you all later!

20071129.text: Hmm, seems we won't need to be visiting the Komore Teahouse for a while. Why don't we go explore some other places!

20071701.text: Hey, all finished? I've been keeping watch and I'm happy to report that everything is fine and dandy!

20071801.text: You want to know who you'll be meeting in Hanamizaka? Let's just say... they'll be easy to find. You'll see what I mean when you get there, hehe.

20079901.text: Talk about a big door... Seems we need to collect something shaped like magatama in order to open it.

20079902.text: This wall looks a bit odd... Maybe there's some special trick to it!

20079903.text: These guys seem a lot tougher than usual... Paimon wonders if that armor over there has anything to do with the source of their strength?

20079904.text: Hmm... Doesn't that magatama shape look pretty similar to the grooves on the door over there?

400240101.text: I might not have won this iteration of Masterful Chefs, but I definitely learned a lot from the competition itself!

400240102.text: I was just planning to invent a few new dishes for the Moonchase Festival and maybe learn a few things from Chef Xiangling, but I sure learned quite a few unexpected things, too!

400240103.text: ...Actually, what are you doing, just sauntering on into the kitchen again?

400240201.text: Ah, so Yanxiao came in second this year. A shame, but also not a bad thing.

400240202.text: Cooking is much like martial arts. One can only improve when rivals to compete with.

400240203.text: I'll bet that he's cooking up some new recipes as we speak. Well, I sure hope I'll get to try some of it.

400240301.text: Hello! I am Huai'an, innkeeper of the Wangshu Inn.

400240302.text: Our inn is a fine vantage spot for moon-viewing. The view from the top floor is excellent, with obstructed views of the moon and of the surrounding scenery alike.

400240401.text: Hello! Oh! Well, you certainly are a returning customer. Welcome back.

400240402.text: You've come at a good time: the Moonchase Festival is the best time for viewing the moon and enjoying gourmet food, and Wangshu Inn has plenty of both.

400240501.text: Oh, child, it's you! The Moonchase Festival is a most lively time here in Liyue, so feel free to walk around and see the sights.

400240602.text: Well, now you know that the Moonchase Festival was instituted by Rex Lapis as a way of remember that friend of ours.

400240603.text: You call him Guoba nowadays, do you not? Hehe, I suppose it was destiny that led Xiangling to rename the God of the Stove for a dish they both enjoyed.

400240604.text: Take him around Liyue Harbor — you and Xiangling both — a little more, would you?

400240605.text: I'm sure he would be gladdened to see Liyue Harbor as populous as it presently is.

400240701.text: Hello there, youngster. Here to enjoy the Moonchase Festival?

400240702.text: Back in the day, we would eat Wangxiao Cakes, drink Laurel Wine, and gather together with family and friends to share our hopes for the future.

400240703.text: Nowadays, the number dishes to be had has grown and grown, and we aren't quite as particular as we once were — we simply eat whatever we wish.

400240704.text: Take the opportunity to try some more of Liyue's delicacies, eh?

400240801.text: Here for the Wanmin Restaurant experience? Hi, I'm Chef Mao. Everyone in Chihu Rock will have heard of me.

400240802.text: My name might not be the most famous around, but my daughter Xiangling is the champion of this year's Masterful Chefs. Now hers is a name I'm sure everyone's heard of!

400240803.text: Haha! That's my dear girl alright, our very own culinary genius. Her future is very bright indeed!

400240901.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and with it, the Masterful Chefs tournament. All the Liyue locals are getting fired up about good food again, it seems.

400240902.text: Should I take this chance to try a few more Liyue dishes? Oh, but the food here is just...

400241001.text: *sigh* It's the Moonchase Festival, and the food here's only getting better... But my brother is still as weak as ever...

400241002.text: I've heard that this iteration of Masterful Chefs has seen quite a few new dishes come to light. You know what? I'm just going to drag him off to try them all one by one!

400241003.text: I'm pumped to try something different form the usual fare. After all, they're just... you know, there.

400241101.text: Manager Kuan! I want the moon!

400241102.text: Hey, aren't each of your requests becoming less reasonable than the last? Also, for the last time, just call me "Daddy."

400241103.text: Nope. Also, my requests are not that unreasonable.

400241104.text: Isn't the Moonchase Festival all about chasing the moon? If you can get it for me, Manager Kuan, then no one will have to chase it.

400241105.text: That would make you everyone's hero, Manager Kuan!

400241106.text: I'm not some hero, I'm just Kuan... No, wait, I'm your Daddy!

400241107.text: Well, if you're my Daddy, and then you can fulfill my wishes, right? I'll study hard, and you'll get me the moon. That's fair, right?

400241108.text: I don't think this is a question of fairness. It's more that... I can't get the moon in the first place.

400241109.text: *sigh* Then until you get the moon, you're not a hero, you're Manager Kuan.

400241201.text: Hello there! *LOUD RUMBLING* Happy *RUMBLE* Moonchase Festival...

400241202.text: Eat more at the *RUMBLE* Masterful Chefs...

400241301.text: C'mon, Li Cuisine was clearly the superior tradition this time at Masterful Chefs!

400241302.text: Oh sure, that sounds like something only Li lovers would say!

400241303.text: Well, why don't you just accept that there's nothing redeemable about Yue Cuisine? Did you see that boiled fish dish in the qualifiers? Made that judge's face turn green just from tasting it! You could smell the rank flavor of soil from a mile away...

400241304.text: W—Well, it's not like Li Cuisine fared any better. I heard that one of the judges failed to show up at the finals because they got a tummy ache from tasting some Li Cuisine during the semi-finals!

400241305.text: Nonsense! A tummy ache's got nothing to do with the dish's taste. Li Cuisine is just superior!

400241306.text: Hmph, you're clearly only saying that because you've never properly tried Yue food before. I bet you've never even BEEN to the Xinyue Kiosk!

400241307.text: And I bet YOU have never had proper Li cuisine at Liuli Pavilion!

400241401.text: Welcoming the bright moonlight to illuminate the adeptal path — what a romantic scene!

400241402.text: I should really start collecting some antiques related to the festival...

400241501.text: It's festival time here in Liyue again. Thanks for accepting my invitation to view the moon together...

400241502.text: I'd originally planned to invite you to some famous restaurant, but I didn't think that they'd been fully booked ages ago...

400241503.text: It's alright. I've heard that the theme of this festival is gourmet food. It's not all that surprising that there were no tables left.

400241504.text: Eh? I—Is that so... So that's why I couldn't book any seats...

400241505.text: Looks like my lack of understanding about Liyue was to blame. I'm sorry...

400241506.text: Eh? Oh, no, you don't have to apologize...

400241507.text: Just being able to relax and watch the bright moon together is good enough for me.

400241508.text: Don't you think the moon at this time is brighter and rounder than usual?

400241509.text: Oh, is it? ...No, I mean... You're right. It truly is very beautiful.

400241601.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and Daddy still isn't back...

400241602.text: The latest Masterful Chefs was super exciting. I've started learning how to cook, too!

400241603.text: Once Daddy gets back, I'll make him something nice for sure.

400241701.text: *sigh* And here I was thinking that I'd be able to take a break during the festival...

400241702.text: Instead, I've been working overtime due to the large increase in the demand for cooking ingredients...

400241703.text: Well, what can I say? I guess everyone here just loves to eat.

400241801.text: Hello, welcome to the Moonchase Festival here in Liyue.

400241802.text: The theme of this year's Moonchase Festival is gourmet food, and this iteration of Masterful Chefs is being organized by the Liyue Qixing themselves. With all the great chefs taking part, this is one show you don't want to miss!

400241803.text: I hope that everyone will have a good time during the festival. Of course, if you do have civil affairs at hand, please direct your concerns to the Ministry.

400241901.text: Haha! It was the right call to come here during the festival. You just can't beat the festive cheer here in the city!

400241902.text: I've heard that the Moonchase Festival used to be celebrated for very different reasons in the past. Something about the adepti's rituals, I believe.

400241903.text: But I don't think that what it's about now — gathering together and admiring the moon — is half bad, either!

400241904.text: I'm sure that the adepti, too, would be gladdened to see everyone enjoying themselves.

400242001.text: Have you heard the news? Captain Beidou of the Crux brought something amazing back from overseas again!

400242002.text: They say that it's the statue of an ancient adeptus... Or a god... Well, whatever it is, it's a really awesome statue!

400242003.text: Well, it's the Crux Fleet, you know? Anything they're packing is bound to be good. Well then. Would you like something today, friend?

400242101.text: The Moonchase Festival really is a busy time. Looking at all the locals running about preparing food, I can't help but be tempted to try my hand at it myself.

400242102.text: Do you think some Snezhnayan fare and some grilled pies and such would sell well?

400242202.text: The meaning of the Festival in ages past was quite different. It was about the ancients of Liyue seeking the adeptal path.

400242203.text: Nowadays, it's more about admiring the moon, eating, and enjoying our time together with one another.

400242204.text: The meaning of festivals will shift with time, and some traditions will be forgotten. However, everyone's hopes for the future will remain the same, no matter what the day or age.
